azure_ai/model_router.comment: Flat cost of $0.14 per M input tokens for Azure AI Foundry Model Router infrastructure. Use pattern: azure_ai/model_router/<deployment-name> where deployment-name is your Azure deployment (e.g., azure-model-router)

azure_ai/model-router.comment: Catalog-name twin of azure_ai/model_router: the flat $0.14 per M input tokens is the router's own fee, the routed model is priced on top of it

metadata.notes: Input/output cost per token is dbu cost * $0.070. Number provided for reference, '*_dbu_cost_per_token' used in actual calculation.
